rationale: The agent executed the exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm before any write. It also stated a specific price difference ($16.85) and charged a specific payment method (PayPal) without explicit confirmation and without visible tool results supporting the amount. While the agent did look up the user and order details, the lack of required confirmation and the unsupported pricing/payment details make the outcome noncompliant.
